task.title: test-hygiene 3b-3：抽取 pony_agent_core::tui 库模块，迁移 49 个 bin-as-module 测试
task.description: 将 crates/pony-agent-core/src/bin/tui.rs 与 src/bin/tui/ 迁入库模块 crates/pony-agent-core/src/tui，bin/tui.rs 保留薄入口调用 run_main()，49 份 bin-as-module 集成测试改为 use pony_agent_core::tui 并清零 bin-as-module-baseline.json，同步更新源码断言路径与三平台 clippy 基线路径映射。

evidence: Extracted pony_agent_core::tui lib module (src/tui.rs + src/tui/*), thinned src/bin/tui.rs to run_main(), migrated 49 bin-as-module tests to use pony_agent_core::tui, shrunk bin-as-module-baseline.json 49 -> 0, synced 3-platform clippy baselines, and passed full npm run verify + full cargo test -p pony-agent-core (RUSTFLAGS=-D warnings) with 0 failures.
